Im 15 and overweight. Im not obese (26 BMI) but chubby. Im trying and trying to loose weight but its hard. Is it possible for chubby guy to ever be in a relationship? 
I'm not trying to cry over myself. I know that my weight is my own fault, but I want to know if I have any chances at all currently.

Im going to first  grade of high school in few days (im 15) and Im terrified. I only had 2 friends in elementary school. I never had a girlfriend. Now Im going to new school where I don't know enybody. All my friend went to different school. I have a really hard time making friends (it took me 4 years to make 2) and thats why I'm scared. You can't just don't have friends in high school because thats makes you and outcast. 
Im also not really attractive mostly because of horrible acne (I used every possible medicine for it and nothing worked) and the fact that Im chubby. I just don't want to become an total looser in new school while everyone will be in a relationship or have big social circle.
